text: Setting clear goals is the first step to a successful project. A useful framework is the SMART method, which ensures your goals are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once your main goal is set, break the work down into smaller milestones. These act like checkpoints, helping you track progress and stay motivated. At each milestone, you should have clear deliverables, or tangible outputs, that you can review. Finally, it is critical to achieve stakeholder alignment from the start. By confirming that everyone involved agrees on the direction and expectations, you can avoid confusion and keep the whole team working towards the same finish line.
